protocol: Selected USAF aircrew chamber training case, age 27. The oxygen mask was removed for a hypoxia demonstration at the reported training altitude and 100% oxygen was restored after symptoms began. Prebreathe and mask-off duration are unavailable.
outcome_window: Symptoms began during the chamber demonstration, recurred after treatment, and were later followed clinically.
locator: Patient history p. 132; Discussion pp. 134 and 136
note: The authors describe DCI and favor contributions from air gas embolism and DCS. Their account gives a single selected case and no exposed roster or unexposed comparator.
